parameters.name: AgentAccessKey
parameters.description:
The AccessKey required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the [DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

> This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server.

parameters.name: AgentSecretKey
parameters.description:
The AccessSecret required to install the CloudMonitor agent. You can call the [DescribeMonitoringAgentAccessKey](~~114948~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
> This parameter is required only when you install the CloudMonitor agent on a non-Alibaba Cloud server.

parameters.name: ArgusVersion
parameters.description: The version of the CloudMonitor agent to install. You can obtain the latest CloudMonitor agent version from [Plugin overview](~~183431~~).

parameters.name: InstanceIdList
parameters.description: The list of instance IDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: UuidList
parameters.description: The list of UUIDs of the servers on which you want to install the CloudMonitor agent. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
